MLPA MICRODELETION/DUPLICATION TEST

ABNORMAL RESULT
Preliminary report:

Detailed chromosome analysis using Multiplex Ligation-dependent Probe Amplification (MLPA) was carried out on DNA extracted from an EDTA blood sample (DNA No 55722), using a kit containing probes for the microdeletion/microduplication regions detailed below.

Three different probes for the region 15q11.2 indicated a deletion. This deletion has been confirmed by in situ hybridization (see separate report).

No duplication or deletion of any other region was apparent.

Please send blood samples in lithium heparin and EDTA from both parents for microsatellite analysis to establish the parental origin of this deletion, and hence to ascertain the clinical diagnosis.

When these studies are complete, an appointment for genetic counselling can be made by writing to the Genetics Clinic, 7th Floor New Guy's House, Guy's Hospital, St Thomas Street, London SE1 9RT, or by fax on 020-7188-1369.

?





	Any genomic position data refers to Build 35 of the NCBI human genome sequence

	Regions covered by the MLPA kit:
	
	

	1p36 (1p deletion syndrome)
	7q11.23 (Williams syndrome)
	17p11.2 (Smith-Magenis syndrome)

	5q35.3 (Sotos syndrome)
	15q11.2 (Prader-Willi syndrome)
	20p12.2 (Alagille syndrome)

	7p21 (Saethre-Chotzen syndrome)
	17p13.3 (Miller-Dieker syndrome)
	22q11.21 (DiGeorge syndrome)
